title: Privilege-Aware Posix Cgroup v2 Isolation & Hierarchical Slice Traversal
author: Brain Harness Autobiographical Reflection Engine (harness-reflector)
context: Sandboxed subprocess plugins executing untrusted external code on Linux require strict CPU and memory resource bounds. However, root-only cgroup v1 or v2 configurations fail in unprivileged container environments (e.g. GitHub Actions runners, Docker without --privileged), causing permission denied errors on boot.

claims.assertion: Discovery of current user slice in /proc/self/cgroup allows unprivileged memory cap application.
Subtree controller validation checks cgroup.controllers before writing limits to prevent runtime PermissionError.
